decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Design and Access Statement, 775/03, 775/01 and 775/06, received on 14/06/2012, plan titled Revised elevation showing rear dormer reduced in width, received on 10/09/2012, plan titled Part of drawing 775/07E, received on 10/09/2012 and plan titled Part first floor, received on 07/09/2012 and 775/04A, received on 04/09/2012) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, rear roof extension with two roof windows to the front of the house.
